BusinessIntelligence.title: Business Intelligence
BusinessIntelligence.description: Understand what sells, what it earns, and what to replenish.
BusinessIntelligence.periodHelp: Complete UTC days, excluding today. Sales are compared with the preceding period of equal length. Inventory reflects current stock.
BusinessIntelligence.profitHelp: Estimated using current costs, before operating expenses.

BusinessIntelligence.noDemand: No observed demand to estimate coverage
BusinessIntelligence.morePriorities: {count} additional products in the table. Filter by signal to review them.
BusinessIntelligence.productsHelp: Separate commercial decisions from stock control. Search and sort to explore the details.
BusinessIntelligence.results: {count, plural, one {# matching product} other {# matching products}}
BusinessIntelligence.noProducts: No products yet. Create your catalog to start analyzing it.
BusinessIntelligence.methodologyHelp: Visible assumptions help you make informed decisions.
BusinessIntelligence.revenueMethod: Only paid, processing, shipped or delivered orders, grouped by creation date. Pending, cancelled and refunded orders are excluded. Net sales = product subtotals minus discounts, allocated proportionally in whole minor units; excluding tax and shipping. Discounts are applied to merchandise first, capped at its subtotal; any excess belongs to tax or shipping and is excluded.
BusinessIntelligence.costMethod: Profit and margin are estimates using current catalog costs: orders do not contain historical cost snapshots. They are not accounting profit and exclude fees and operating expenses. A recorded zero cost is treated as zero.
BusinessIntelligence.restockMethod: Coverage = stock / average daily demand, rounded down. Alerts appear at zero stock or coverage no greater than lead time. Suggested quantity = demand for the greater of target coverage and lead time, rounded up, minus stock. No quantity is suggested without sales. Estimates exclude incoming purchases, seasonality and time spent out of stock.
BusinessIntelligence.signalsMethod: Signals prioritize stockouts, replenishment, no sales, then margin below 20%. Sort by profit to identify losses. Inactive or archived products retain their sales but receive no purchase recommendations.
BusinessIntelligence.variantsMethod: Products with variants retain sales and estimated margin using the base product cost. Stock, coverage and replenishment require reviewing individual variants and are not estimated from base stock. They are excluded from simple inventory value.
